invariants.statement: Ledger admission never allows more than capacityLimit occupied agent slots at once, counting ledger-active assignments plus declared externalOccupied; QUEUED and BLOCKED records hold no slot
invariants.atomicity: single-writer lease; admission decision is synchronous
runtimeConsequences: too many live agents violates the platform 5-agent cap
oracles: assignment history + status transitions recorded per admission

invariants.statement: A reserved slot is freed only by observed terminal lifecycle (terminated/finished/exited/cancelled/closed); a result message or lease timeout alone retains the slot
runtimeConsequences: slot leak if release never verified

invariants.statement: Exactly one terminal SEALED_RESULT is accepted per requestId; identical replay is idempotent; changed payload for same id or conflicting terminal content is rejected; foreign-state messages are flagged stale and cannot advance phase
forbiddenStates: two different SEALED_RESULT payloads on one requestId
oracles: recorded messages and rejected attempts in transcript

invariants.statement: All ledger mutations run under the coordinator lease; saves are atomic via tmp+rename; events form a hash chain with contiguous sequence
illegalTransitions: event seq gap or broken prev-hash
runtimeConsequences: concurrent coordinator splits authority if lease bypassed

invariants.statement: Assignment records claiming live occupancy bind a real dispatched context via observedRuntimeId, and independent-review evidence requires genuine fresh contexts - fabricated occupancy is a limitation that must be recorded, not claimed as verified
validStates: RESERVED assignments correspond to dispatched or dispatchable work
forbiddenStates: phantom agents counted as real concurrency
postconditions: releaseEvidence names the observed termination proof
illegalTransitions: claiming verified exit with no agent
invariants.failureBehavior: unverifiable binding reported as limitation, not success

findings.title: Stale flag computed but never persisted on message records
